source.acceptance_criteria: bd writes emit no auto-backup warning, and either a working backup destination is registered or auto-backup is explicitly disabled.
source.description: Every bd write prints: auto-backup failed: register backup remote: add backup backup_export: Error 1105: failed to create directory '<repo>/.beads/backup': mkdir /home/jagger: permission denied. Writes themselves succeed; the warning is cosmetic but fires constantly and pollutes agent output. Root cause is server-side: the shared Dolt server (pid 13623, user=jagger, root=/, HOME=/home/jagger) cannot create ANY directory under /home/jagger, including ones that already exist (.beads/backup exists, created Aug 2). 'bd backup init <path>' fails identically for /home/jagger/.beads/backups/core. Separately, the shared server's cwd is /home/jagger/projects/xtrm-tools/.beads/dolt — an abandoned pre-rename clone, not core. 0 backups registered; durability currently comes from the VPS origin remote only. Fix likely requires restarting the shared Dolt server from a correct data dir; deferred because a restart disrupts all beads lanes.
source.title: bd auto-backup fails on every write: Dolt shared server cannot mkdir under /home/jagger
